lineage.strategy: Add current primary commercial-pipeline and product-deployment evidence rather than repeat Q2 cash-flow evidence.

observations.fact: Mobileye reported Q2 2026 revenue of $508M, approximately flat year over year, raised the midpoint of full-year revenue guidance to a $1.970B-$2.020B range, and said MOIA public user testing in Hamburg with safety drivers remained on track while its vertically integrated robotaxi preparations accelerated.

risks.risk: Current-quarter revenue was roughly flat year over year and robotaxi commercialization remains pre-scale; guidance and deployment milestones do not establish future unit economics or adoption.

unknowns.unknown: Economics, utilization and timing of scaled robotaxi revenue remain unproven in current operating results.

recommendation: Use the current revenue/guidance and robotaxi execution milestones as source-addressed inputs; Alpha retains numeric underwriting authority.
